notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Lightning Greaves attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Lightning Greaves attached, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Lightning Greaves's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.
